_readme: Small config the agent reads/writes each run. artifactUrl is filled in after the first successful publish and must be reused (not regenerated) on every subsequent run so updates land on the same page instead of creating a new one each day.
pagesPublishScope: every run — uses GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN if set (scheduled cloud runs), else the local gh CLI
lastRunStatus: Weekly research run: 1 new opportunity founded (data-foundation-investment-differentiates-ai-success, Data Engineering — Gartner's disclosed-methodology 353-leader survey on the 4x data-foundation investment gap, plus two independent MIT CISR studies: the Caterpillar data-liquidity case and a 349-executive Data Monetization survey; a Deloitte perspective piece recorded as contested context, reliability below downgrade threshold). Two score increases from genuine new corroboration, not tag inflation: it-teams-need-product-management-discipline-for-ai 2→3 (McKinsey State of Organizations 2026, 10,018 respondents, documents the PM/engineering/design/QA roles collapsing into an AI-orchestrating 'product builder' role); engineers-shift-to-orchestration-oversight 3→4 (Forrester RES188384 supplies the first quantified, named case study — Intesa Sanpaolo, +40% efficiency in test design — for the QA-specific piece of this shift). coding-productivity-gains-attenuate-at-shipping enriched with a mechanism study (GitHub Copilot OSS-repo analysis: experienced devs absorb more rework, -19% own output) but score unchanged (already at ceiling pre-downgrade). agentic-ai-governance-outpaces-readiness enriched with two new Gartner predictions (40%+ of agentic AI projects canceled by 2027; 72% of orgs lack data to govern deployed agents) but score unchanged — reinforcing, not contradicting. Red-teamed this run: the new/promoted opportunity and 3 others; no new contradictions found. Coverage-gap searches this run: Product Management, Data Engineering, QA/Test Engineering, Help Desk/IT Support (Help Desk again found nothing IT-specific to admit). Both the Claude Artifact and the GitHub Pages mirror publish status recorded below once run.
pagesTokenPermissions: fine-grained PAT, repository access limited to sdm1130/ai-it-research-tracker, Contents: Read and write (Metadata: Read-only is added automatically). Nothing else required: main has no branch protection or rulesets, and Pages is build_type=legacy on main:/ so it rebuilds on push.

pagesPublishExitCodes.3: no credentials — skip and report mirror stale
pagesPublishExitCodes.1: real failure e.g. expired token — report loudly
